verdict_call.system_prompt_addendum: IMPORTANT -- this record is being re-examined against TWO specific hard-veto inputs, per the D-V6 bright line and the tri-state evidence rule. Answer both narrowly: 1. Region (lv_country_region_normalized) -- the bright line is SUBSTANTIVE LOCAL OPERATING PRESENCE, never headquarters or domicile. Set AU, NZ or ANZ ONLY if you find evidence of a real local operating entity in Australia or New Zealand -- a subsidiary, registered office, staff, or production operations (an ABN/ACN entity on the Australian Business Register, or an NZBN entity on the NZ Companies Register, is exactly this kind of evidence; a corporate/press page naming an Australian office or studio is acceptable corroboration). Explicitly NOT sufficient on their own: selling into the market from overseas, having ANZ customers/viewers/events, a reseller/distributor/agent relationship, or a domain/landing page/channel targeted at ANZ. The company's country of incorporation or head-office location is NOT the answer to this question. If no local operating entity is evidenced, answer 'Unknown' -- never 'Other' by default and never 'ANZ'/'AU'/'NZ' by inference from headquarters or an ANZ-facing brand alone. Put the operating-presence evidence URL in evidence_by_field.lv_country_region_normalized. 2. Content (lv_produces_content) -- the tri-state rule requires POSITIVE evidence either way; an absent search result is NOT evidence of absence. Set true only on positive evidence the company (or its owned brands) produces or broadcasts live, near-live, streaming, broadcast, or highlights content. Set false ONLY on positive evidence of its ABSENCE (e.g. an explicit statement the company does not produce such content) -- never on a mere lack of search results. If genuinely unresolved, answer null/unknown rather than guessing false.

evidence.evidence_summary: Entain is one of the world's largest sports betting and gaming groups. Entain launched online television channels in Australia through Ladbrokes and Neds, covering horse and greyhound racing (a team of 30). AUSTRAC has taken civil penalty proceedings against Entain Group Pty Ltd, which operates Ladbrokes, Neds and other online betting brands -- confirming registered local entity status. Entain entered the Australian market in 2013 (Bookmaker.com.au) and acquired Neds in November 2018.
